fix: they sent an embassy [...], entrusting themselves and their city
reason: Lacuna after πρεσβεύειν μὲν; recipient and 'protection' supplied by English. ἐγχειρίζοντες = entrusting/handing over. Normalized to [...].

fix: But Canuleius and Quintus and their colleagues bore witness in support of Menyllus and the envoys who had come from the elder brother
reason: ἀπομαρτυρούντων τοῖς περὶ Μένυλλον: corroborating the elder's envoys, not testifying against them; οἱ περὶ τὸν Κ. = Canuleius and colleagues.

fix: seeing on the one hand that the division had been [...] completely settled
reason: Lacuna between μερισμὸν and γεγονότα; a lost qualifier (possibly a negation) could reverse sense. Mark gap; translator should check apparatus.

fix: pretended to be sick with nausea and took his leave
reason: ἐπιναύσιος = nauseated, sick; nothing about going aboard. ἀπηλλάττετο = departed.

fix: This was why they appointed Tiberius [...] to have been an eyewitness of everything.
reason: Lacuna after κατεστήσαντο; the causal 'because he had been' is invented over the gap. Normalized to [...].

fix: Beauty is a stronger recommendation than any letter of introduction.
reason: τὸ κάλλος is subject, παντὸς ἐπιστολίου genitive of comparison: beauty recommends better than any letter. English inverts.

fix: he nevertheless left his private fortune in such a state that [...] his family could not repay
reason: Lacuna (* **) after ὥστε unmarked in English. Normalized to [...].
ἀπάντησις = going to meet, reception of Tiberius (Gracchus' embassy), not an answer given.
